name: 30 Kilowatt Hours Left
source:
You (Paul) woke up one day to find the world in shambles--everyone but you has disappeared. You have no idea what happened, as there's no one to ask---no people, no animals---but there are creatures that are attracted to the dark, so you must keep the lights on. The sun seem to be smaller, so days and especially nights are freezing, forcing you to use your heater that sucks up a good amount of power. Your last hope---a radio that lasts abut 5-7 minutes after its battery's been charged for 6 hours. 

You've finally made contact with a girl, Elly, and only have a short amount to chat each day to maintain sanity. However, your makeshift generator is now left with only 30 kilowatt hours of power on its final tank of gas---running your heater 6 hours a day would mean it'd be dry in 5 days, and only two things can be plugged in at a time. You must balance running your heater, your microwave, your lights, and time on your radio and keep the unknown creatures at bay for as long as you can. 

You may never find out why the world was laid to waste when you woke up, but you don't have to be alone.

[From [url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/30-kilowatt-hours-left]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你（保罗）有一天醒来，发现世界一片混乱——除了你之外的所有人都消失了。你不知道发生了什么，因为没有人可以问——没有人，没有动物——但有些生物会被黑暗所吸引，所以你必须让灯开着。太阳似乎变小了，所以白天，尤其是夜晚都很寒冷，迫使你使用消耗大量电力的加热器。你最后的希望——电池充电6小时后可持续使用约5-7分钟的收音机。

你终于和一个叫Elly的女孩取得了联系，每天只能聊一小会儿，以保持理智。然而，你的临时发电机现在最后一箱煤气只剩下30千瓦时的电力——每天运行你的加热器6小时意味着它会在5天内干燥，而且一次只能插入两个东西。你必须平衡加热器、微波炉、灯和收音机时间的运行，并尽可能长时间地阻止未知生物。

当你醒来时，你可能永远不会明白为什么世界被夷为平地，但你不必孤单。
